messages.subject: Invitation: Real Estate Update seminar — 5 March (CPD)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

The property team is running its quarterly Real Estate Update on Wednesday 5 March, 12.30–14.00 in the 14th floor seminar room (lunch provided). Topics: the latest on the Building Safety Act, MEES tightening, and a TOGC refresher. 1.5 hours CPD. Reply to register.

Donna
